I would not recommend this place to anyone looking for a quality haircut for their dog. Honestly, I’ve received better grooming results at Petco, PetSmart, and just about anywhere else.

Before the appointment, I submitted pictures to show the groomer exactly how I wanted the haircut to look. Unfortunately, the final result made it seem as though those instructions were either completely disregarded or the groomer was simply rushing to finish the job. What makes this even more frustrating is that I waited over 30 minutes in the lobby past the expected completion time, only to receive a subpar haircut and an incomplete grooming service.

I also find it ironic that the business has a late pickup fee policy for customers who don't pick up their dogs on time, yet when customers are left waiting well beyond the expected completion time, there is no acknowledgment of the inconvenience, no discount, and apparently no concern about the quality of the service being provided. I understand that delays can happen, but the lack of consideration is disappointing, especially when the final result doesn't justify the wait.

To make matters worse, two of my dog's nails were left completely untrimmed. While most of the nails were trimmed, missing two of them is an oversight that should not happen when you're paying for a grooming service.

Overall, this experience was extremely disappointing, and I will not be returning. If you're looking for a groomer who takes pride in their work, follows your instructions, pays attention to detail, and values customer satisfaction rather than rushing through appointments, I strongly recommend looking elsewhere. There are better options available, and I would encourage other pet owners to consider them.

I wish I had paid closer attention to the negative reviews before bringing my Bichon here. Many of the concerns described in those reviews were similar to my own experience.

When I booked Lily’s appointment, I specifically told the owner that I wanted a different haircut than the one she had previously received (I didn’t like the previous one they had done so that’s why I asked for a diff cut) and explained that I would provide reference photos. At drop-off, the owner was shown the photos and was told the requested style could be done.

Unfortunately, the finished groom looked nothing like the photos provided. Lily’s face was uneven and poorly shaped, her legs were noticeably different lengths, and her ears still appeared dirty despite ear cleaning being included in the grooming package.

Most concerning, Lily’s nails were trimmed so short that they bled afterward, and she appeared uncomfortable walking when we got home. For a service that cost $120 including tip, I expected much better care and attention to detail.

What disappointed me most was how my concerns were handled afterward. I contacted Melissa respectfully in an effort to discuss the issues and reach a resolution. Instead of a constructive conversation, I felt the response was dismissive, confrontational, and unprofessional. Rather than addressing the concerns, the discussion quickly became adversarial on her end.

After reviewing other customer feedback more carefully, I noticed multiple reviews describing similar experiences involving grooming concerns and negative interactions when customers attempted to discuss problems.

I understand that mistakes can happen in any business. What matters is how those mistakes are handled. In my experience, there was a lack of accountability, professionalism, and customer service throughout this situation. Based on my experience, I would not return and cannot recommend this business.

I am new to this area of San Antonio and was searching for a new groomer when I came across Glam Pet Groom. Upon arriving at the establishment, I noticed a sign that said "No Refunds". I now know that I should've taken this as a HUGE RED FLAG and I regret leaving my dog in their care!!

Upon initial arrival we were greeted by Melissa who was very polite and friendly but I had no idea this friendliness was going to be a cover up for the botched grooming job that was done on my dog!

About 3 hours after dropping my dog off I received a text that my dog was ready for pick up. Upon returning to the establishment we waited an additional 15 min and then Melissa came out to greet us, WITHOUT my dog. I thought this a little strange but let it go. Melissa then proceeded to tell me that my dog was "wild" and that if I decided to groom her again I should give her a calming treat prior to the appointment. I have a Goldendoodle who I know has a lot of energy and can be excitable so I apologized for her level of energy. Melissa then took my payment of $135 + a 15% tip. Only after I paid did she bring my dog out. Upon first look, the overall grooming was a little rough, but I didn't complain because I know she is a high energy dog. I should have taken a closer look at the overall grooming, but I trusted that my dog would've been cared for. Needless to say, the grooming was AWFUL!

Upon arriving at home I had to redo the shaping around her face and trim a lot of missed areas. While doing this I noticed that my dog had been nicked in several places, including next to her right eye!! I also found a huge chunk of fur missing from one of her ears that was covered up! Needless to say, I was furious!!

I realize that my dog is a high energy dog and things could happen by accident if she was moving around. What PISSES ME OFF is that Melissa made sure that I paid prior to me even seeing my dog and then she did not disclose any of the nicks or grooming errors!! I would've been more understanding if I was at least told about these problem areas before I left.

- I was not offered any kind of apology for hurting my dog. I can only imagine how scared she must've been after getting nicked the first time, especially with a total stranger!

- There was no attempt to take responsibility or offer any kind of discount for these egregious mistakes!!

- All of which was TOTALLY UNPROFESSIONAL and absolutely irresponsible!!

I am writing this review in hopes that another dog owner who is contemplating having their dog groomed at Glam Pet Groom, absolutely RECONSIDER AND LOOK DOR A DIFFERENT GROOMER!! I entrusted my dog's well-being and safety with these people and absolutely regret it!!
